# VS Code themes

`src/ui/VsCodeThemes.cpp` reproduces the colors of these themes:

| Theme | Source | Version | Copyright |
|---|---|---|---|
| One Dark Pro | [Binaryify/OneDark-Pro](https://github.com/Binaryify/OneDark-Pro) | 3.20.3 | Copyright (c) 2013-2022 Binaryify |
| Dracula | [dracula/visual-studio-code](https://github.com/dracula/visual-studio-code) | 2.25.1 | Copyright (c) 2016 Dracula Theme |
| GitHub Dark | [primer/github-vscode-theme](https://github.com/primer/github-vscode-theme) | 6.3.5 | Copyright (c) 2020 Primer |
| Tokyo Night | [enkia/tokyo-night-vscode-theme](https://github.com/enkia/tokyo-night-vscode-theme) | 1.1.2 | Copyright (c) 2018-present Enkia |
| Catppuccin Mocha | [catppuccin/vscode](https://github.com/catppuccin/vscode) | 3.19.0 | Copyright (c) 2021 Catppuccin |
